title: Fourier coefficient of the bent dual
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f:\mathbb{F}_2^n\to\bbr$, and suppose $n$ is even. For every $x\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$, the vector Fourier coefficient of the bent dual of $f$ at $x$ equals $2^{-n/2}f(x)$.
